## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask gate` passes locally (or I rely on CI)
- [ ] Deferred work has an issue (`deferred`, `decision`, `accepted` or `finding`), and resolved issues are closed with `Fixes #N`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`, and its `Bump:` line is still right (dependency-only changes may skip this)
- [ ] Semver impact stated: none / patch / minor / major
